events.event: Wall Street fell sharply on 5 November (New York) on fears of an AI bubble and slower data-centre buildout after Democratic midterm wins, with Nvidia down over 9% and the Magnificent Seven losing over US$1 trillion; Korea's Kospi dropped nearly 9% at the Friday open.
events.key_numbers: Wall Street market value erased about US$2.5 trillion (≈Rp45,000 trillion, detikInet) · Magnificent Seven lost over US$1 trillion (≈Rp18,200 trillion, CNBC Indonesia) · Nvidia down over 9%, over US$440 billion lost · Nasdaq down over 5%, worst day since 4 Apr 2025 · S&P 500 tech sector down 7.30% (CNBC Indonesia; its S&P 500 daily % is internally inconsistent, one outlet says 4.4%) · Kospi down nearly 9%, 20-minute halt on 6 Nov
events.why_it_matters: The AI boom behind chip, RAM and data-centre prices, and a lot of pension and fund money, just took its biggest one-day hit in 19 months.
events.spreading_evidence: Two CNBC Indonesia tech headlines and two detikInet headlines on 6 Nov; CNBC Indonesia and detik both led with the Rp18,000T / Rp45,000T numbers

events.event: The FBI, CISA and the US health, transport and agriculture departments issued a joint warning to disconnect internet-connected commercial refrigeration controllers after hackers raised temperatures in supermarket freezers in the US and Europe.
events.key_numbers: At least 3 hacks in recent months · second wave hit over 100 European stores · Irish chain SuperValu: 13 of 223 stores affected (2 Nov) · France attack in October reportedly cost tens of millions of euros · Pentagon probing an August outage at a US base grocery store
events.why_it_matters: Smart appliances you can reach over the internet can be turned into weapons against food and medicine supplies, a new kind of hack that spoils stock instead of stealing data.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNBC Indonesia and detikInet (two angles, blood bank and supermarket)

events.event: The Dutch cabinet announced it will cut about 25,000 civil-service jobs (16%) over 10 years and have AI take over routine tasks, in what CNBC Indonesia calls the first large plan to cut permanent staff because of technology.
events.key_numbers: 16% of civil servants, about 25,000 posts, over 10 years · savings €900 million in 2027 rising to €3.5 billion (≈Rp71 trillion) by 2035 · civil servants grew from 140,000 (2021) to 170,000 (2026) per Telegraaf · police and defence excluded · AI plan details due Q1 2027
events.why_it_matters: A rich country is openly planning to replace civil servants with AI, a question Indonesia's PNS and PPPK workforce will eventually face.

events.event: TikTok launched a standalone TikTok Shop app for iOS and Android in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines, not including Indonesia, with in-app checkout, livestream shopping and free-shipping offers.
events.key_numbers: 4 launch markets (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines) · iOS and Android · Indonesia not listed · no user or sales figures disclosed
events.why_it_matters: TikTok Shop in Indonesia is now run with Tokopedia, so a separate app next door raises the question of whether Indonesian shoppers and sellers are next, just before 11.11.

events.event: Muhammadiyah launched ChatHPT, an AI chatbot that answers questions from 1,153 official Majelis Tarjih rulings and links to the sources.
events.key_numbers: 13,840 questions as of 2 Nov 2026 · top topic prayer (salat) with 2,671 questions · 1,153 HPT documents · testing began Aug 2026 · built on the AIMU platform
events.why_it_matters: One of Indonesia's biggest religious organisations is putting AI in front of millions of followers, with a limit that it explains rulings but does not issue new ones.
